observations.body: Luke calls the figures men in this scene; the later travelers report a vision of angels without erasing Luke’s description
observations.label: Witness boundary

observations.body: Luke’s tomb witness names two men in dazzling clothing who ask why the living is sought among the dead and call the women to remember Jesus’ words.
observations.label: Account sequence

payload.posture: Read “Two men in dazzling clothing address the women” as its own Scripture scene before carrying its imagery into another heavenly gathering.
payload.tension: the passage shows angelic or angel-associated testimony at resurrection and its human recipients, while Luke calls the figures men in this scene; the later travelers report a vision of angels without erasing Luke’s description.
payload.title: Two men in dazzling clothing address the women
